input.title: Missing technical specifications for PV modules
input.message: The item 'Photovoltaikmodule 450 Wp liefern' lacks essential technical details such as module type (mono/poly), efficiency class, dimensions, weight, and applicable standards (e.g., DIN EN 61215). This violates the requirement for clear and exhaustive descriptions under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 and STLB-Bau standards.
input.suggestion: Specify module technology, dimensions, weight, efficiency, and relevant standards (e.g., DIN EN 61215, IEC 61730).
